title: Velvet Isobar
description: Willow Hesitation returns above a changed bass and pauses in an empty bar. Its melody expands, passes into the lower hand, and opens into two seven-note flights. A late recollection gradually releases the repeating ground. The last upper notes fall away while the lower harmony remains held.
technical_note: Keep the three-three-two bass supple and the written empty bar fully silent. The lower-hand song needs its own legato and foreground. Place each 7:6 upper group over three quarter beats, then let the broad final recollection release its pulse without an exaggerated slowing.

performance.note: Authored phrase breathing and melodic voicing; independent rhythm is written in the score, with a shared tempo map.

composition_time_source: Recorded when the first score was saved.

audio_reverb.description: Subtle warm room; preserve the clarity of moving voices.
